description: A 49-second scripted fly-around of a small grass terrace cut into a hillside by the sea, with an apple tree, an L-shaped wooden fence (with a gate) running up to the tree's trunk, a stone water channel, a rail track, a stone post with torches and a glass window. 0:00-0:12 the tree close up, 0:12-0:15 the fence at the trunk, 0:15-0:21 the channel, 0:21-0:27 the track, 0:27-0:36 around the post, 0:36-0:42 the window, 0:42-0:49 the terrace from above.
